sections.changelog: 3.0.0-alpha.27: Responsive Paint Unification. Desktop and mobile now share canonical model paint; mobile-only legacy paint overrides are removed. Existing converted Home hero/tagline paint is repaired in the model, future hero conversion uses canonical olive, and Alpha.26 Header/Footer/menu behavior is preserved.
